name: vvibe
description: Integrate VVibe services into any project: GA4 analytics, member sync, invitation email, pre-deploy security scanning, Product Knowledge Base extraction, SEO blog writing and rendering, and product change logging.

interface.shortDescription: Analytics, members, email, SEO blog, and security scanning for VVibe creators.
interface.longDescription: Skills that act on your own VVibe account, plus the vvibe MCP server. The first tool call opens your browser to log in — sign-up is on the same page, and there is no API key to copy.
defaultPrompt: Set up VVibe analytics in this app.
Build my VVibe Product Knowledge Base from this repo.
Run a VVibe sentry scan before I deploy.
